svg.title: MK-677 (ibutamoren): what has actually been tested
svg.desc: MK-677 (ibutamoren): what has actually been tested. Raises growth hormone and IGF-1: Repeatedly shown in Merck-era trials, including older adults. Verdict: Shown in people. Adds lean (fat-free) mass: About 1 kg more than placebo over a year in healthy older adults. Verdict: Shown, modest. Reduces body fat: Total and belly fat unchanged in older adults and obese men. Verdict: Not shown. Strength and physical function: No change in older adults; mostly no gain after hip fracture. Verdict: Not shown. Deeper sleep: One small study: 8 young and 6 older adults, 1-2 weeks. Verdict: Preliminary. Bone density: Bone turnover up; extra density gain at only one of four sites. Verdict: Weak. Slowing Alzheimer's disease: 563 patients for 12 months. Verdict: No effect. Safety signals: Blood sugar up, insulin sensitivity down; heart-failure signal. Verdict: Real concerns. Approved drug or sport-legal: No FDA-approved product; on FDA safety-risk list; banned by WADA. Verdict: Neither.
